title: Evidence-Gated Dual-State Docking and Machine Learning for Functional Classification and Virtual Screening of A2A Adenosine Receptor Ligands

scientific_claim.primary: An independently evaluated, evidence-gated chemistry model can rank direct human A2A Ki measurements with quantified applicability and uncertainty.
scientific_claim.docking: Dual-state docking is evaluated as a separate structural evidence channel and as a predeclared incremental predictor; it is not assumed to improve potency prediction.
scientific_claim.md: Gated molecular dynamics tests control and candidate pose stability on the declared time scale; it does not create activity labels or rescue a failed external model gate.
scientific_claim.autonomy: The dashboard demonstrates a provenance-first shadow-mode literature-to-candidate loop. Autonomous records remain quarantined until computational evidence gates pass.

primary.name: pBind_Ki
primary.definition: negative base-10 logarithm of molar direct-binding Ki for wild-type human ADORA2A

prohibited_pooling: Ki with Kd, IC50, EC50, or generic pChEMBL

primary_external_predictor.name: AB_Ridge
primary_external_predictor.selection_basis: best frozen v1.5 repeated grouped-CV pBind_Ki result before external outcomes
primary_external_predictor.features: ECFP4 radius 2, 2048 bits, plus frozen physicochemical descriptors

development_reproduction.grouping: generic Murcko scaffold with exact structures sharing a group

external_confirmation.outcome_firewall: No numeric Ki value, derived pKi, or outcome-dependent statistic may influence membership, review order, structure standardization, applicability thresholds, model choice, or docking selection.

computational_evidence_gate.pass_1: deterministic metadata, identifier, structure, target, endpoint, unit, relation, and provenance validator
computational_evidence_gate.admission_rule: admit only when both passes independently accept and all agreement fields match
computational_evidence_gate.failure_rule: quarantine missing evidence, ambiguity, or any disagreement; never resolve by predicted activity

external_confirmation.minimum_floor_failure: If fewer than 60 molecules or 20 generic Murcko scaffolds pass, report a stress-test cohort and do not weaken the floor.
external_confirmation.primary_success: AB_Ridge external R2 bootstrap lower bound above zero and RMSE improvement versus the frozen training-mean baseline has a paired 95 percent interval excluding zero.
external_confirmation.docking_increment_success: On identical external records, E_RF minus AB_RF delta-R2 lower bound above zero and delta-RMSE upper bound below zero.
external_confirmation.promotion_rule: Only a model satisfying its predeclared external gate, provenance, calibration, applicability, artifact-hash, and computational release checks may be displayed as externally confirmed.

md_v1_6.membrane: symmetric 70:30 POPC:cholesterol molar composition using one audited Amber-compatible parameter set

gdp_policy.reason: GDP is absent from deposited biological assembly B/D and rigid transfer from chain C produced a 0.9768 A severe clash with Ala D366 CB.
gdp_policy.implementation: Do not transplant GDP across asymmetric-unit copies. Build every 5G53 B/D-derived v1.6 control and sensitivity system as explicitly nucleotide-free mini-Gs.
gdp_policy.claim_limit: The active Tier A control tests a nucleotide-free mini-Gs-bound construct and cannot establish GDP-dependent stability.

tier_a.pass_rule: Each control passes in at least two of three replicas using the frozen pose and native-contact criteria.

md_v1_6.trajectory_start_gate: No trajectory may start until ligand parameters, completed constructs, membrane systems, native contacts, minimization, NVT, NPT, geometry, energy, composition, and hash audits pass.

agent_may: run authorized frozen scoring and docking workflows
agent_may_not: call a computational candidate an experimentally validated hit
dashboard.demonstration_exit: One source-to-candidate vertical slice with complete provenance and a reproducible shadow-mode replay.
